Contact us HOW CAN WE HELP The Oncology service offers comprehensive management of canine and feline cancers, covering all aspects of the investigation, diagnosis and treatment of oncological disease in small animals. We work closely with clinical pathology, diagnostic imaging (CT and MRI) and the surgical services to ensure accurate diagnosis and the best possible treatment and quality of life for our patients. We offer a wide range of treatments including surgery, chemotherapy and radiotherapy as well as more novel therapies such as immunotherapy (melanoma vaccine) and new targeted therapies such as tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
